SD_1_matrix.no_dominance_reading: no dynamic is best in every ecology. FREEZE_V1.md section 3 registered the worst-in-every-ecology half 'with the exception recorded exactly'; any dynamic listed in dynamics_worst_in_every_ecology is that recorded exception and its cause is given in SD_3_nas_meta.

SD_2a.claim: Under OPAQUE, expected evaluations to hit is >= (|X|+1)/2 for any oracle-only dynamic, with equality iff it never repeats a query.

SD_2b.claim: Hamming agreement is separable across positions, so exact coordinate descent hits in at most 1 + ell*(n-1) evaluations.
SD_2b.mechanism: separability of the objective, NOT any property of gradient methods; the substrate has no differentiable structure

SD_2b_scaling.note: GRAD's cost is linear in ell, ENUM's expected cost is exponential; the separation floor therefore grows without bound in ell at registered scope. Exhaustive start-point verification is run by route B at ell in {6, 8}.

SD_2c.GRAD_accident_condition: restart point agrees with the target on every position except possibly position 0
SD_2c.LS_accident_condition: restart point within Hamming distance 1 of the target
SD_2c.claim: Under DECEPTIVE, the local-search trajectory converges to the decoy z. Since z differs from the target w in every position, no point on that trajectory (other than the restart point itself) can be within one coordinate of w. Hits are therefore possible ONLY through a restart accident, and the accident condition is exact.

SD_2d_target_independence.claim: under OPAQUE every dynamic's query sequence is target-independent, so hit counts are a coverage lottery and guidance buys nothing

SD_2e_mut_objective_invariance.claim: objective-blind dynamics (MUT, NAS, RAND) must have identical census rows in every ecology; a difference would prove an ecology leak in the common frame

freeze_criterion_disposition.as_frozen: OPAQUE: guided dynamics must NOT beat the RAND control
freeze_criterion_disposition.replacement_test: SD_2d target-independence: same dynamic, same seed, two different targets must emit identical query sequences up to the first hit. This is exact and mechanical, and strictly stronger than the hit-count comparison it replaces.
freeze_criterion_disposition.single_stage_attribution: the frozen criterion measured a HIT COUNT, but under OPAQUE the objective is constant off the target, so no dynamic can use guidance at all and the hit count is a pure coverage lottery in which small differences (133/136 vs 129 of 200) carry no information about guidance. The criterion was mis-specified, not the theory.

META.coverage_dilution_identity: a portfolio with |arms| equal shares gives its enumeration arm exactly |X|/|arms| evaluations, so the completeness guarantee that ENUM alone carries (a hit within |X|) survives only for targets of index < |X|/|arms| - i.e. exactly a 1/|arms| fraction of the space
META.reading: budget portfolios do not come free: splitting the budget destroys the completeness guarantee of the one arm that had it. This is a derived accounting identity, not a measured preference.

NAS.reading: representation search is not a separate kind of search: its charged outcome is decided by REP-1/REP-2 on the target at hand, and REP-2 predicted every pool member's sign before it was run.

battery.expected: accepted on w* alone, rejected on the registered distribution
